purpose: Determine whether Binance Spot's Price Range Execution Rule is a direction-independent positive-payoff mechanism or only a safety constraint, without spending a live venue-configuration request.

agent_native_index.classification: GET /api/v3/executionRules, GET /api/v3/referencePrice, and GET /api/v3/referencePrice/calculation are listed without USER_DATA or TRADE labels

official_mechanism.scope: execution-time taker price constraint around a continually changing reference price
activation_requirements: the symbol has a PRICE_RANGE rule
the symbol has a non-null reference price
the relevant side and direction multiplier is present
official_mechanism.limit_freeze_point: the reference price is recalculated when the order enters its taker phase and its execution limits then apply for that taker phase
official_mechanism.outside_range_behavior: the taker order expires with EXECUTION_RULE_PRICE_RANGE_EXCEEDED

buy.user_intent: execute quantity q only at prices less than or equal to worst acceptable price P
buy.comparator: otherwise identical marketable LIMIT IOC or LIMIT FOK buy with limit P
buy.guarantee: every comparator fill price is less than or equal to P regardless of the exchange-set Price Range rule

sell.user_intent: execute quantity q only at prices greater than or equal to worst acceptable price P
sell.comparator: otherwise identical marketable LIMIT IOC or LIMIT FOK sell with limit P
sell.guarantee: every comparator fill price is greater than or equal to P regardless of the exchange-set Price Range rule

dominance_proof.residual_quantity: The rule can expire residual taker quantity beyond its exchange-set range. The user-bounded comparator can impose the same or a tighter explicit bound and therefore weakly dominates the rule as a price-protection mechanism.
dominance_proof.market_order_comparison: Avoiding an extreme fill versus an unbounded MARKET order is safety value, not an independently positive edge, because the user can choose the bounded comparator before submission.

request_efficiency.reason: No possible BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, or SOLUSDT configuration can make the exchange-set cap positively dominate an otherwise identical user-bounded order. A live configuration request cannot change the terminal economic classification.
request_efficiency.future_configuration_use: Query exact current public rule and reference-price state only inside a separately frozen candidate whose decision materially relies on unbounded MARKET execution or exact residual-expiry semantics.

adjudication.reopen_only_on: a material official rule or order-type change that gives the exchange rule positive cash consideration, strictly better executable price, or a protection unavailable through a user-bounded order; ordinary live multiplier or reference-price changes do not qualify

platform_correction.required_behavior: Any future candidate that intentionally uses an unbounded MARKET taker path must source-bind current executionRules and referencePrice state and model EXECUTION_RULE_PRICE_RANGE_EXCEEDED residual quantity.
platform_correction.not_required: Do not add a collector or generic polling loop for strategies that already use explicit limit prices.

prohibited_shortcuts: comparing only with an avoidably unbounded MARKET order
assuming the fictional FAQ values are live BTC ETH or SOL configuration
polling executionRules or referencePrice without a decision-changing candidate
ignoring residual expiry in a future MARKET-order execution model
